body.p: The cape of the gods. Brother and sister were alive, they did nothing but wander around. With girls. Then at the end, when they traveled like this, they set up a tent at the Cape of the Gods, [Brother] says, "Probably this is Numto (God's lake)," - he says, - "which various people used to talk about." It turns out that there is a large lake on all sides. Even before their arrival, [this place] was called the Cape of the Gods. Her brother has built a tent a little higher up on tufts of moss at this cape of the gods. Looks like it has been converted into a settlement area. Coming from somewhere, probably. Either they have run away somewhere or they are simply telling a story that has been forgotten. Then a tent was set up behind this lake, near a cedar tree. Then she says to her brother: "Oh, we'll put a tent in a holy place, I'll look around, there's water everywhere on this lake, there are so many islands", - she says. "Have we not covered the holy places where the gods come down with a tent? On the great cape of God, it seems, we have set up our tent on the holy land. Near the great cape of the gods, in the tundra." Her brother simply has no words, just to put up the tent, turned around, and that was it. Then her brother fell asleep for a long time from that moment on. He's all asleep, one day [the sister] wakes her brother, says, "Oh, the army is coming." On a bright day. It seems like someone is saying, "[There] is only one person, let's just go and get started." So they came and surrounded the tent on two sides. [The sister] stuck the door shut with sticks, they started pulling on the door. It turns out that the door was closed. Then she shows the buckles of her belt in the hole in the door to the street. So that they understand what it means: "Take me away, let my brother live." She buys her brother's head off and goes herself instead. Then you hear one of them say, "Belt buckles, he showed women's belt buckles, let him stay [to live]?" They will probably buy a woman. We used to understand it like this: Probably [her brother] did some deeds, probably. Yes, then it was probably: "Ladies' buckles came." Here is for a woman to buy. The leader of the warriors says audibly, "My soul is not such that a woman would bend it, what kind of buckles are these. Come on, open the doors." Yes, the door was torn open immediately, of course, even though it was reinforced with sticks, because the tent is not strong, this is not a house. Simply, audibly, he says: "A woman is not needed." Well, they understood, some say: "Women's buckles have probably shown that he will have to give up his sister." Yes, indeed, her brother is asleep. She wakes up, wakes up, at least he would have killed one! Completely asleep, once and for all. His blood covered him so that he knew nothing. They flew into the tent, all axe knives stuck in it. And they took them with them. When he woke up, things might be different. The brother's body remained there, there, in the collapsed tent, there are all kinds of tools, bucket kettles, but a little to the left of the Cape of the Gods. A huge copper pot, eaten away by the winds. Only the ears [of the boiler] remained where the iron is thick.
